outcome: Reduction of need for second-line therapies for postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 84 women with severe postpartum hemorrhage unresponsive to uterotonics
finding: In women with severe postpartum hemorrhage refractory to uterotonics, rhuFVIIa reduced the need for specific second-line therapies compared to standard care.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery (vaginal or Cesarean section) did not affect the primary outcome (reduction of need for second-line therapies).
